_readme: This is Tagify's single shared settings file.
Edit the values below, then double-click run_tagger (or run 'python run_tagger.py').
Do NOT rename any of the keys (e.g. 'client_id', 'api_key') — only edit the values.
Every other setting (Whisper/Demucs options, genre thresholds, mood prototypes, etc.) still lives inside each script under scripts/ — this file only holds the source folder and API credentials.

spotify._comment: Create an app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard to get these two values.

lastfm._comment: Get a free API key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create

musicbrainz._comment: MusicBrainz has no API key — it just asks every app to identify itself with these three fields. Only providing the app name(any but without space) works [optional] Set 'contact' to your email or a URL so MusicBrainz can reach you if their API team ever needs to.
